boundaries: The new application and service results are current-host diagnostics on a shared machine with five measured repetitions per cell.
The Oxipng feature rows measure complete Cargo feature closures. Small deltas overlap same-run dispersion and do not establish causal speedups or regressions.
The unialloc_type_isolation and unialloc_pac Oxipng cells select runtime feature closures without the MIR semantic rewrite. Use typeiso_perf versus typed_plain for actual Type Isolation policy cost.
This x86_64 host cannot measure ARM hardware PAC cost. The unialloc_pac application row is software-fallback build evidence only.
The hugepage Cargo feature used explicit HugeTLB mappings. mimalloc MIMALLOC_ALLOW_THP controls Linux transparent huge pages. These mechanisms are reported separately.
TCMalloc keeps process THP eligibility enabled. Under the host madvise policy it made no MADV_HUGEPAGE request and all measured AnonHugePages counters remained zero.
The rseq and pthread_dtor rows establish build selection. Repository audit found no active allocator callsite for rseq outside its module and no direct pthread_dtor cfg use.

The Oxipng GNU-time peak RSS metric omits the separately reported explicit HugeTLB footprint on this host. The unialloc_hugepage process sample recorded 56,740 KiB VmHWM plus 8,192 KiB HugetlbPages; report both values for memory interpretation.

A future UniAlloc-owned rseq registration must use libc-managed rseq state or disable glibc registration before creating an independent per-thread registration; the current feature row exercises neither path.
